title: Roasted Butternut Squash
description: Butternut squash roasted hot with onion and fresh sage, glazed with a little maple syrup.

steps.heading: Prep the Squash
steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Peel the squash and cut it in half, scoop out the insides with a spoon and discard, then cut into cubes.

steps.heading: Prep the Rest
steps.text: Cut the onion into large pieces and roughly chop the sage.

steps.heading: Season
steps.text: Put everything on a baking sheet, drizzle the oil and maple syrup over, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and mix well.

steps.heading: Roast
steps.text: Roast for 12 minutes, stir, then roast another 10 to 12 minutes.

notes: The original card lists the squash, onion and sage without amounts; one medium squash is about 2½ lb.
